sentences.en: He leans to the left side of the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 他偏向政治光谱的左端。

sentences.en: The alt-right exists on one end of the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 极右翼存在于政治光谱的一端。

sentences.en: You can see the colors of the spectrum in a rainbow.
sentences.zh: 你可以从彩虹中看到光谱的颜色。
